proves.claim: a second command start at the same main tip and HEAD asks for the pinned tool build with no git call and the same answer

cli.io-pinned-tool-build.repeat-read-no-.why: Without it every command start would pay two git processes for an answer that has not changed.

proves.claim: after main or HEAD moves the next start asks git again and picks the new answer

cli.io-pinned-tool-build.tip-moves-rerea.why: Without it a cached answer could outlive the commit it was read at and pin a stale build.

proves.claim: a repeat show at an unchanged main tip and HEAD runs none of the policy, pinned-tool-build or rowOrigins git reads the first show made

cli.io-commands-show.startup-reads-cache.why: Without it a cache that is keyed wrong could pass its own cell's test yet leave every show paying the startup git reads.

proves.claim: show on the real-size fixture board finishes under 500 ms wall with warm caches

cli.io-commands-show.real-size-under-500.why: Without it the startup caches could land and show still be slow on a production-size board.
